constraints: Deny by default; verify active tenant membership and asset scope for every request and task.
Executive may access only aggregate reports/trends; never raw evidence, findings, graph or signed technical downloads.
Role membership is server managed; JWT user metadata never grants roles.
Approver must differ from plan author and executing operator; role unions cannot bypass this.
Privileged roles require Supabase aal2; AAL is read from validated JWT, never browser input.
Owner is not an automatic remediation or approval superuser. Role escalation is audited.
